title: Practice surfaces
intro: Same discipline outside the chat: decisions, lanes, secrets, brand, media convert, and the publish proof class. One list — not a second copy of the same cards.

surfaces.title: Desktop MCQ dialogs
surfaces.body: Decision forks use a desktop multiple-choice dialog — not markdown A/B/C walls. Dangerous arms are marked; the referent (draft/path) stays visible in the ask.

surfaces.title: Tiered send authority
surfaces.body: Draft freely. Light carve-outs for trusted contexts; everything else fail-closed with a human gate showing the full message.

surfaces.title: Secrets dialog → Bitwarden
surfaces.body: Capture through a desktop dialog into Bitwarden — not Composer. Password Manager for human logins; Bitwarden Secrets Manager for machine/agent tokens. Confirm length or success — never echo the value into chat, logs, or commits.
surfaces.lesson: Isolate tokens from the AI conversation.

surfaces.title: Delete → trash folder
surfaces.body: When removing project files, move them to the OS trash or a project trash folder first. Empty trash only as a separate, deliberate step.
surfaces.lesson: Soft delete buys recovery; rm spends it.

surfaces.title: Parallel agent lanes
surfaces.body: Named lanes with owns / never / handoffs. One writer per tree. Tickets for REQUEST/ACK/DONE when peers must coordinate.
surfaces.lesson: Team-shaped solo work needs explicit ownership.

surfaces.title: Voice as a medium
surfaces.body: Inbound STT and short outbound TTS when voice fits. Same trust and send rules as typed chat — plus a confirm step before speech becomes the ask.

surfaces.title: Convert / media pipeline
surfaces.body: Bounded convert steps turn office docs and media into text or intermediates for the task — instead of stuffing opaque binaries into every prompt.
surfaces.lesson: Convert with purpose; discard intermediates you will not keep.

surfaces.title: Brand as a skill
surfaces.body: Loadable brand procedures keep email, web, PDF, and UI on one visual and verbal system across agent sessions.
surfaces.lesson: Brand is a procedure, not a vibe prompt.

surfaces.title: Specification documents
surfaces.body: Git markdown is source of truth; branded DOCX/PDF are exports; Drive mirrors are for comments. Ingest comments back into the SoT.

surfaces.title: Design-share / Pages review
surfaces.body: Generate → verify → share on a gated Pages review (Look/Inspect) so humans judge atmosphere and fit without mystery ZIPs.
surfaces.lesson: Share the review surface, not an ungoverned dump.

surfaces.title: CI publish checks
surfaces.body: Content sync → automated content checks → Playwright UX (desktop + mobile). Green checks are the publish proof class — not “looks fine locally”.
surfaces.lesson: Publish is a proof class, not a hope.
